parse.title: Tango (Flash God)
parse.text:
If you were looking for a different Tango unit, see Tango (disambiguation)

Overview

Tango (Flash God) is a MythicalMythical. He is only obtainable by evolving Tango (Score).

Evolving

Tango (Flash God) can be evolved from Tango (Score) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Attacks starting from Upgrade 8 are able to hit air type enemies.
  • After Update 14.0.0, Tango (Flash God) has been given the Rose Damage type, along with other units without a second damage type.
  • Tango (Flash God) has also been given 50% crit chance which can be useful.
  • After the rerelease of the game, Tango (Flash God) has recived a damage buff with a few other units like Hubris (The One), JIO (Over Heaven), Umbra (Nuclear).
